orthogonal_allocation_matrix.description: Fixed orthogonal allocation of inpainting tools across authentic sources to eliminate confounding

canvas_and_codec_controls.scientific_interpretation: Canvas/codec normalization controls output container and resolution parity between pairs. It does NOT claim to erase pre-existing sensor JPEG compression history or eliminate all potential pipeline shortcuts.

inclusion_criteria: Image must decode successfully with Pillow without errors.
Pixel dimensions must be exactly 512x512 RGB.
Binary mask PNG (512x512) must accompany each ai_edited sample with values in {0, 255}.
Must pass decompression bomb guard (<= 50,000,000 pixels).
Verified provenance documentation for authentic image.
exclusion_criteria: Overlap with any of 684 historical Option P sources by source_id.
Overlap with any historical Option P image by image_sha256.
Overlap with any historical Option P image by origin_id / Flickr URL.
Resolution mismatch between authentic and ai_edited within the same source.
Synthetic or non-photographic authentic images (e.g., pure computer graphics, screenshots, text diagrams).

sampling_and_stopping_rule.rule: Process candidate pairs in prespecified random order; lock and seal cohort manifest immediately upon reaching 400 verified valid pairs. Zero model scoring permitted during collection.
